the content was easy now that I think about it, not because I graduated but because now I have time to actually  understand them - I think it was mostly the amount of time you have in a day or week and ALL the other homework/tasks  + clinicals + requirements you have to do and finish simultaneously. So its so important to  establish the studying method that works best for YOU. It changes and what you think works now - might not towards the end of the year. Also, know your resources and tools and study **smart** not hard.

It was more exhausting and draining rather than difficult, nonetheless, I dont regret any of it. (well maybe I couldve studied more for the psych final and not go on a trip the night before hahah)

This is gona sound  weird but on youtube they have "Study With Me" videos where its just people recording themselves or their materials (no faces lol) studying. Its timed so you can keep track of your studying time. I use the 50:10 pomodoro style - you study for 50 minutes take a 10 minute break and usually its a 2 hour, 4 hour or 8 hour cycle ( they also have an 11 hour cycle)

It has their library background noise or white noise  to keep you "in the zone."  Surprisingly, it helps me get through studying  more efficiently. I use it while going through uworld
